summary: Ukrainian forces conducted strikes against strategic fuel storage in Udmurtia and Crimea, targeting the 'Prioritet' plant and logistics depots. Russia launched a massive drone attack involving over 390 UAVs targeting the Moscow region, resulting in residential damage in Chekhov. Significant logistical disruptions are reported in the Kharkiv region following the destruction of over 80 gas stations.
key_points: Ukrainian forces struck the 'Prioritet' plant in Udmurtia, a strategic facility used for long-term storage of fuel and petroleum products (Source: @UkraineNow/82973).
Over 390 drones were launched toward the Moscow region, causing residential damage in Chekhov (Source: @eRadarrua/102969).
Russian forces destroyed more than 80 gas stations in the Kharkiv region, leaving the Kharkiv–Poltava route without refueling stations (Source: @UkraineNow/82977).
A 'Forpost-R' reconnaissance UAV, capable of carrying guided aerial bombs, was shot down over the Kursk region by a 'Chaklun-KM' interceptor (Source: @UkraineNow/82960).
Ukrainian forces targeted fuel and logistics depots in the Ichki area of occupied Crimea (Source: @UkraineNow/82973).
A Russian drone warehouse in the Chernovopopivka area of the Luhansk region was struck (Source: @UkraineNow/82973).
More than 81 drones were intercepted approaching Moscow during the night (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31971).
A Russian drone warehouse in the Chernovopopivka area of the Luhansk region was struck (Source: @UkraineNow/82973).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by high-intensity UAV warfare targeting both civilian infrastructure and strategic logistics. Russia's massive drone strikes on Moscow indicate a continued capability to project power deep into Russian territory. Ukrainian strikes on fuel facilities in Udmurtia and Crimea demonstrate an ability to target strategic depth and supply lines.
sections.regional_response: Romania has responded to airspace violations by expelling a Russian diplomat and summoning its ambassador for consultations. The use of F-16 fighters for interception in Romania highlights increased NATO-aligned defensive measures in the region.
sections.intelligence_notes: The destruction of over 80 gas stations in the Kharkiv region represents a significant logistical blow to Ukrainian mobility along the Kharkiv–Poltava route. The use of 'Forpost-R' UAVs with laser-guided bombs indicates a sophisticated aerial threat in the Kursk direction.
